question: Which company developed the AlphaFold protein structure prediction system?

subquestions: Which company developed the AlphaFold protein structure prediction system?

args.query: AlphaFold protein structure prediction system Google DeepMind developed

observations.content:
Summary: AlphaFold is an artificial intelligence program developed by DeepMind, a subsidiary of Alphabet. The sources indicate that AlphaFold was initially developed by DeepMind and later, in 2024, AlphaFold 3 was co-developed by Google DeepMind and Isomorphic Labs, both subsidiaries of Alphabet. In 2026, Google announced that the team behind AlphaFold had been disbanded.

[1] AlphaFold - Wikipedia
    https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/AlphaFold
    AlphaFold is an artificial intelligence (AI) program developed by DeepMind, a subsidiary of Alphabet, which performs predictions of protein structure. It is designed using deep learning techniques. [...] [edit")]

Announced on 8 May 2024, AlphaFold 3 was co-developed by Google DeepMind and Isomorphic Labs, both subsidiaries of Alphabet. AlphaFold 3 is not limited to proteins, as it can also predict the structures of protein complexes with DNA, RNA, post-translational modifications and selected ligands and ions. [...] Google announced in 2026 that the team behind AlphaFold had been disbanded, with most being reassigned to work on Gemini while others moved to Isomorphic Labs or left the company entirely.

observations.content:
Summary: AlphaFold is an AI system developed by Google DeepMind that predicts a protein’s 3D structure from its amino acid sequence. It regularly achieves accuracy competitive with experiment. Google DeepMind and EMBL’s European Bioinformatics Institute (EMBL-EBI) have partnered to create AlphaFold DB to make these predictions freely available to the scientific community. The latest database release contains over 200 million entries, providing broad coverage of UniProt. AlphaFold 3, announced on 8 May 2024, was co-developed by Google DeepMind and Isomorphic Labs, both subsidiaries of Alphabet, and can predict the structures of protein complexes with DNA, RNA, post-translational modifications and selected ligands and ions.

Summary: AlphaFold is an AI system developed by Google DeepMind that predicts a protein’s 3D structure from its amino acid sequence. AlphaFold 3, released on May 8, 2024, was developed jointly by Google DeepMind and Isomorphic Labs, both of which are subsidiaries of Alphabet. AlphaFold 3於2024年5月8日發表，由Google DeepMind與同構實驗室共同開發，兩者皆為Alphabet的子公司。AlphaFold 3不再侷限於蛋白質，還能預測蛋白質與DNA、RNA、轉譯後修飾及部分配體與離子所形成之複合物的結構。
